---
title: "⚠️ Complications"
subtitle: "Recognize complications early"
---

Recognize complications early. Understand patterns. Prevent avoidable harm.

::: {.callout-tip}
### Normal / Expected Position
**Target:** Frontal horn near foramen of Monro.

- Tip should float freely in CSF
- Avoid ventricular wall contact
- Confirm on CT after placement
:::

  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  // Live listener — updates automatically whenever Complications
  // changes in Firestore, no page reload needed.
  return Generators.observe(notify => {

      notify(snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data()));
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  });

```{ojs}
// Deterministic color per category name — same category always
// gets the same color, no manual mapping to maintain.
function categoryColor(name) {
  const palette = ["#007AFF", "#34C759", "#FF9500", "#AF52DE", "#FF3B30", "#30B0C7", "#FF2D55", "#8E8E93"];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  return palette[Math.abs(hash) % palette.length];
}
```

```{ojs}
groupedComplications = {
  const groups = new Map();
  complications.forEach(c => {
    const key = c.category ?? "Uncategorized";
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
    groups.get(key).push(c);
  });
  return [...groups.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
}
```

```{ojs}
groupedComplications.length === 0
  ? html`<div class="fs-empty">No complications documented yet — check back soon.</div>`
  : html`<div>
    ${groupedComplications.map(([category, items]) => {
      const color = categoryColor(category);
      const pearls = categoryPearls[category];
      const pearlsHtml = pearls ? `
        <div class="callout-pearl" style="margin-top:14px;">
          ${pearls.prevention.length ? `
            <strong>💡 Prevention Pearls</strong>
            <ul style="margin:8px 0 12px;padding-left:20px;">
              ${pearls.prevention.map(p => `<li style="margin-bottom:4px;">${p}</li>`).join("")}
            </ul>
          ` : ""}
          ${pearls.insight.length ? `
            <strong>⚠️ Clinical Insight</strong>
            <ul style="margin:8px 0 0;padding-left:20px;">
              ${pearls.insight.map(p => `<li style="margin-bottom:4px;">${p}</li>`).join("")}
            </ul>
          ` : ""}
        </div>
      ` : "";

      return `
        <details class="fs-accordion">
          <summary class="fs-accordion-summary" style="background:${color};">
            <span class="fs-accordion-name">${category}</span>
            <span class="fs-accordion-count">${items.length}</span>
          </summary>
          <div class="fs-accordion-body">
            ${pearlsHtml}
            <div class="fs-grid" style="margin-top:14px;">
              ${items.map(c => `
                <div class="fs-card">
                  <img class="fs-card-image" src="${c.imageURL ?? ""}" onerror="this.style.display='none'" onclick="fsOpenLightbox(this.src)" />
                  <div class="fs-card-body">
                    <h4 class="fs-card-title">${c.title ?? "Untitled"}</h4>
                    <p class="fs-card-desc">${c.description ?? ""}</p>
                    <p class="fs-card-meta">${c.source ?? c.contributor ?? ""}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              `).join("")}
            </div>
          </div>
        </details>
      `;
    }).join("")}
  </div>`
```
